CODEFLUX TESTDATA POLICY

Only synthetic or explicitly redistributable fixtures may be stored here.
Never copy private repositories, customer data, provider credentials, tokens,
personal paths, production URLs, or unredacted logs into testdata.

Every repository fixture must identify its synthetic purpose in a nearby
non-secret source or test comment. Secret-scanning fixtures must use documented
non-live markers that cannot authenticate to a real service. Generated,
temporary, or failure-capture output belongs under .artifacts/, not testdata.
